entries.rationale: SCRUM-887 review at PR head 064307d81 (same call, new location): SCRUM-887 moved the suppliers.create call out of components/suppliers/SupplierSelect.tsx into the shared hook useSupplierCreateFlow in components/suppliers/useSupplierCreateFlow.ts so the new Suppliers screen and the picker share one create path. Read the hook submit callback, newIdempotencyKey and convex/suppliers.ts create. The idempotencyKey argument is unchanged: keyRef is a useRef of string or null, assigned with ??= newIdempotencyKey() (supplier-create: plus crypto.randomUUID) immediately before the call, and the backend requires a string and uses it for idempotency after tenant and finance authorization. The call also spreads the typed create fields and the optional confirmDistinctFrom, sharedLegalIdentityOf and sharedLegalIdentityReason arguments, all declared by the existing create validator. convex/suppliers.ts only adds the listForManagement and searchForManagement queries; create is unchanged. The extractor still does not prove the mutable ref value and reports any, so this stays accepted TYPE_UNKNOWN debt. Fingerprint and cause are unchanged and must still match the live spec in the production monitor run; that match was not observed locally (contract-skew spec rendering is unavailable on this machine). No runtime, concurrency or full-contract certification.
